title: Cousins in Binary Tree
description:
Given the root of a binary tree with unique values and the values of two different nodes of the tree x and y , return true if the nodes corresponding to the values x and y in the tree are cousins , or false otherwise. 
 
 Two nodes of a binary tree are cousins if they have the same depth with different parents. 
 
 Note that in a binary tree, the root node is at the depth 0 , and children of each depth k node are at the depth k + 1 . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/02/12/q1248-01.png] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,3,4], x = 4, y = 3

Output:
 false
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/02/12/q1248-02.png] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,3,null,4,null,5], x = 5, y = 4

Output:
 true
```

 Example 3: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/02/13/q1248-03.png] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,3,null,4], x = 2, y = 3

Output:
 false
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [2, 100] . 
 
 1 <= Node.val <= 100 
 
 Each node has a unique value. 
 
 x != y 
 
 x and y are exist in the tree.
